title: Major Lewis flying Rosethorn 007
description: Major Lewis smiles from the pilot's seat in flight aboard Rosethorn 007, visor down, boom mic at his lips, EMERGENCY EXIT stenciled on the yellow cockpit frame beside him. Larry, photographing from a crew position, remembers marathon days aboard this aircraft — once taking off at 4 a.m., refueling at Qui Nhơn (where he bought his camera at the PX), and returning at 11 at night, rain clouds pouring down across the country.
researchNotes: Larry's own identification (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0016-c18032603.json). First appearance of Major Lewis in the archive; identity research notes in research/people/major-lewis.md. The Qui Nhơn PX camera purchase connects to the Canon Dial 35 Larry says he bought (VN-0023 comment) — the likely source of much of this collection.
